definition: Pseudonymous participant code (P01-P58). One session per participant.
C00 = manual work, without robot or voice; C10 = autonomous robot, voice disabled; C11 = autonomous robot with voice commands.

Boxes deposited in their correct zone during the round. Only completed (valid) rounds are included, so the value is always 5.

Recorded failure events: count of logged events whose name ends in "_failed", plus "multimodal_intent_rejected" and "task_failed" (subsystem faults, retries, rejected intents, robot sequence failures).
